author: GoPro
description:
This is winter through the lens of a GoPro ❄️ From deep powder lines and massive backcountry sends to heli drops, snowmobile missions, ski BASE jumps, alpine summits, raw POV moments and more. Watch as the best skiers, snowboarders, mountain bikers, climbers, and adrenaline junkies push the limits in some of the harshest conditions on Earth. Here is this season's best moments from the 25/26 winter season captured on GoPro MAX2 and GoPro HERO13 Black.
